tasks.text: Survey energy measurement: on-chip counters (RAPL), external wattmeters, software estimators (CodeCarbon, Scaphandre, PowerJoular).
Survey benchmarking methodology: bias sources (warm-up, DVFS, background load, virtualisation), repetitions, non-parametric statistics, effect sizes.
Select 4 workloads and their candidate variants; write the state-of-the-art report.
Energy meters: Windows Energy Meter Interface (RAPL package and cores), Linux powercap RAPL, software model for cross-checking.
Seeded multi-source datasets in 7 storage formats; 11 workload variants validated by result checksums; one isolated process per run.
Automation: warm-ups, randomised rounds, idle baseline and drift, background-load check, statistics pipeline, tests; protocol document.
Pilot campaign on machine A (5 studies, 10 repetitions per configuration), first statistical analysis, results dashboard.
Full campaign (30 repetitions) and a second machine: Linux with RAPL, run from the pinned Docker image.
Final analysis: cross-machine comparison, sensitivity to data scale, model-vs-hardware validation.
